processes.limitation: Visible process names only; exact catalog matches are not verified identities or evidence of active use. Hidden, renamed, inaccessible and browser-hosted applications may be missed. No executable paths, arguments, PIDs or full process inventory are returned.

displays.limitation: Active logical displays only; mirrors, virtual displays and physical monitors cannot be reliably distinguished. A single display does not exclude external capture.

overlays.limitation: Visible window metadata only, not proof of assistance or capture exclusion. System UI and legitimate utilities can match; hidden windows, other desktops and inaccessible metadata may be missed. No titles, owners, PIDs or images are returned. macOS sharing state does not establish modern capture behavior; Windows capture affinity is not inspected.
